name: app-case-study-thank-you-slide-with-photo-strip
title: Dark thank-you slide with photo-booth strip and credits
whatItIs: A charcoal slide with a tilted white photo-booth strip of a team, 'Thanks for taking the time!' at the top centre, and credit text at left and right in small caps.
whatItMeans: Personal and warm; the polaroid strip humanises a technical project.
techniques: Use a photo-booth strip as a friendly sign-off image.
Set a short human thank-you in large light type.
Split credits and process notes to opposite sides.
Tilt the photo slightly to break the grid.

vocabulary.definition: A vertical strip of snapshot photos.
A list of contributors and roles.
The last slide thanking the audience.
A photo rotated a few degrees for informality.
